 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
which must be performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title 
block.
This 
pump is used to suction the sludge wasting water from the DAF tank and 
discharged it in the sludge thickner.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy 
Hegazy, accepted by eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Sludge oil separation pump | P-605/606
MANUFACTUR | NETZSCH
MODEL &TYPE | NM038BY01L05B Horizontal Screw Pump
SPEED | 290R.P.M CW
POWER CONSUMED | 2.2KW
LIQUID HANDIED | Thickened Sludge
CAPACITY | 10 M/H
HEAD | 15M
MOTOR POWER | 2.2KW
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller.
band wrench for stator assembly
chain wrench for stator assembly
stator clamp for stator assembly
stator assembly device
set hexagon socket screw
set pin extractor
torque wrench
caliper gauge with depth scale
assembly pincers for circlip
filling device for gear joints
packing screw
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the noisy of the pump.
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do
Check the Temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Pump out of operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Check the mechanical seal leakage
Check the pump and piping flanges for leaks
Check the bolts fixation
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the 
following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.
Open the valves and vents
Filling the pump casing with the medium , in case of high 
 viscosity media fill with the liquid .pump priming is vital to ensure 
 lubrication of the rubber stator
Fill the piping on the pump suction side in anti-clockwise 
 rotation only: fill the pump housing
Attendance and checking during 
operation of the pump, the following should be checked:
Check of flow rate and delivery head
Check the shaft seal for leaks
